targets.authors: Wills H ,  Kamps D ,  Fleming K , &  Hansen B
targets.title: Student and teacher outcomes of the class-wide function-related intervention team (CW-FIT) program
targets.evidence_quote: The purpose of this study was to provide a close conceptual replication of the first CW-FIT RCT ( Wills et al., 2016 ) by using methods of the original study and following procedures as closely as possible ( Cook, 2014 ;  Coyne et al., 2016 ).
targets.outcome_quote: Effects in this CW-FIT study provided a successful replication for student and teacher outcomes, indicating positive findings and significantly better performance for high-risk students in intervention classes than for those in the comparison classrooms ( Wills et al., 2016 ).
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly give an overall successful replication verdict for student and teacher outcomes. Smaller Tier 2 effects and differences among sites do not override that verdict.

reasoning: The paper explicitly selects the first CW-FIT randomized trial, Wills et al. (2016), as its close conceptual replication target. Other CW-FIT papers provide background, procedures or convergent contextual comparisons; the 2018 report concerns the present multisite project rather than an independent original being retested.
